name: Classic Banana Bread
description: Moist & easy banana bread with a crackly top.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 175°C and butter a loaf pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix wet ingredients
recipeInstructions.text: Mix wet ingredients: stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas, then mix in the sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir in. Add the flour and mix until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake for 60 minutes, until a tester comes out clean.
